reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 09, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png; checked navy cap, graying covered temple hair, pale brows, absence of facial hair and glasses, one mouth, uniform and shoulder board, pose, crop, lighting, collar fit, complete card/note/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The dark navy peaked cap with gold front insignia and gold visor decoration, short graying hair at the covered temples and pale eyebrows remain. The chin is smooth with no moustache or beard, there is one stern closed mouth and no spectacles. The nearly frontal capped head angled subtly toward viewer left, direct-to-slightly-left gaze, squared shoulders, chest-up crop and subdued warm light with visor shadow are retained. One dark navy jacket, white pointed shirt collar, one dark tie and one visible gold shoulder board at viewer left remain. The collar fits directly around a short broad neck beneath the rounded chin, without a long yellow column, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque light muted photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with compact upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 following actual white/cyan/alpha viewing; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and values 252-254 alone were not treated as defects.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact cap insignia and shoulder embroidery are unreadable and the hairline is mostly covered at 65x67; only visible source-scale shapes, colors and placements were compared without inventing exact symbols or extra hair. Note marks remain indistinct rather than readable text.
